project.name: local-video-forge-first-deliverable
project.style: clean technical documentary, subtle cinematic lighting

shots.narration: A local video pipeline should turn a deliberate frame into controlled motion.
shots.motionPrompt: The presenter remains composed while the camera makes a very slow controlled push forward. Subtle natural breathing and a slight head movement. Stable framing, consistent face and lighting, no scene change.
shots.negativePrompt: distorted face, excessive camera shake, morphing objects, duplicate objects, sudden cuts, generated text
